items.summary: 列出選舉日要看的流動性價位：下方 $75K、$76.2K；上方 $82.6K、$85K、$87.5K。
items.reply: Our OKX-only liquidation estimate lines up: long clusters at 75.2–76.3K and 74.0–74.8K, shorts at 82–83K and 84.9–85.9K. Within ±5% of the Nov 3 close, ~7.2K BTC of longs sit below vs ~3.7K BTC of shorts above. An estimate from one venue.
items.note: 他的 $76.2K 落在推算多單帶裡，$85K 落在最大空單帶裡；配圖標出他提到的價位。

items.summary: Coinbase 溢價自 10/6 起每小時都是負的，10/30 低點 −0.30%、現在 −0.19%；美國 ETF 30 天 −12 億美元。問美國買盤何時回來。
items.reply: Daily data agrees: Coinbase premium 7-day avg hit −0.19% on Nov 3, the lowest since our series began in January (299 days). Asia isn't stepping in either: OKX P2P USDT/CNY trades at a 1.14% discount.
items.sources: Coinbase 溢價 7 日均 −0.190%（11/03，2026-01 起 299 天最低）；OKX 場外 USDT/CNY −1.137%（11/03）

items.author: DumpDetected
items.name: DumpDetected
items.summary: （印尼文）OI 升到 109.8 億美元、資金費率 +0.0098%、幣安永續／現貨成交量比 15 倍，ETF 仍在流出；質疑反彈沒有現貨支撐，並建議停損、留 USDT。
items.reply: 0.0098% per 8h is ~10.7% annualized, the same as the OI-weighted rate across Deribit, OKX and Hyperliquid. Spot says the opposite: Coinbase premium 7-day avg −0.19%, lowest since January. K33 also flags CME OI at a 3-year low.
items.sources: 加權資金費率年化 10.7%；Coinbase 溢價 7 日均 −0.190%；K33（11/02）CME 未平倉三年低點
items.note: 跳過：原文是印尼文（Grok 標成英文），結尾是停損建議。只回中文和英文貼文。
